programme.title: Extinct or Alive: Land of the Lost Sharks
programme.desc: Wildlife biologist and conservationist Forrest Galante dives into some of the most treacherous, shark-infested waters in the Southern Hemisphere all in an attempt to rediscover three unique sharks lost to science for as long as 100 years.

programme.title: The Zoo: The Kings of Queens
programme.desc: A trio of new penguin chicks are introduced to the pool for their first swim family dynamics change when the mandrill monkey troop welcomes a new baby a pair of king vultures are prepped for their big debut at the Queens Zoo.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet: New Body for Lolly
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff preps a Shiba Inu for surgery after she's struck by a car Dr. Baier performs his first-ever wild goose operation an obese Yorkshire terrier struggling to walk begins a strict weight-loss plan.

programme.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Shark Island
programme.desc: Biologist and predator specialist Dave Salmoni journeys to an island in the South Pacific, which is home to a large concentration of sharks.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Steve's Legacy Continues
programme.desc: After months of croc-wrangling training with Steve Irwin's best friend Wes, Robert, Steve's son, takes the final step in his journey to feed Graham, a huge crocodile at the zoo's famous Crocoseum.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans: Climbing And Nest-Building
programme.desc: Peanut is reluctant to climb twins Ceria and Sen need training to stop their misbehavior Boogie Boy must learn to build a nest.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.
programme.desc: From rhino saviors and lion researchers to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. Ivan journeys to four separate countries.

programme.title: Alien Sharks: First Contact
programme.desc: Mysterious and bizarre alien sharks lurk far beneath the waves in deep waters where researchers are on a quest to make first contact pursuing the elusive frilled shark, sleeper shark and cookie cutter shark brings even more unexpected encounters.
